author: Honesty_03
text_post: It seems to me that you are in a LJBF zone.  I could be wrong but that's how it seems to me.  I read a post by Braddock that say in order to get out of the LJBF zone you have to disconnect from.  Freeze-out for a period of time and then come back better.  How long?  He said months, but I am sure that each situation is different.  But you have to avoid being put in the LJBF zone from the beginning.  The moment you meet her you must escalate and flirt and let it be know that you are not just some dance buddy.  Make sure she sees you as a potential partner!  By not talking to her when she is right next to you, you seem like you are uncomfortable around her and nothing, in most cases, is less attractive that lack of confidence. And the last thing I think you would want to do is to make a big deal about it.  I wouldn't advise confronting her about it.  Just kinda act like it doesn't even bother you.  But you have to set up a strong frame and it doesn't seems like you are doing that.  I don't know how you could get out of the LJBF zone, if that is the case, if she tries to hang out with you every week. Hope that helps some.
